name: KEYS & SAND
premise: Six design-led holiday apartments by the sea in Dubai, booked direct instead of through the big platforms: stay search, apartment pages and booking.
look: bright, sunlit, lived-in holiday interior photography like a design-hotel campaign, natural light, soft shadows, 28-35mm, photorealistic
palette: chalk white, sea blue, sand, terracotta and natural rattan
direction: The anti-listing. Instead of wide-angle rental photos, every apartment is shot like a design magazine story: morning light, an open book, linen moving in the breeze, the sea always in the frame. Six apartments, each with one signature colour against chalk white. The site should make a guest want to book direct for the feeling, not the price.
type: friendly rounded serif headlines, handwritten-feeling numerals for nights and guests; warm off-white backgrounds.
anchor: a low, five-storey whitewashed apartment building right on a sandy beach in Dubai, with deep curved balconies, sea-blue painted shutters, built-in planters of bougainvillea and olive, and a quiet sea-facing courtyard with a small pool
consistency: Generate 01 first; keep the building description word for word in exterior shots.
Interiors share chalk-white walls, oak floors, linen and rattan; each apartment adds one colour (sea blue, terracotta or sand) as noted.

shots.title: Morning on the balcony
shots.prompt: Bright photograph from inside a holiday apartment out through open glass doors to a deep curved balcony of {anchor}: two rattan chairs, a small table with coffee and a bowl of figs, sheer linen curtains lifting in the breeze, the turquoise sea and a pale sandy beach beyond, warm morning sun, relaxed and inviting, nobody present.

shots.title: The shutters
shots.prompt: Vertical photograph of a tall window with sea-blue painted shutters folded open on a white wall, a branch of bougainvillea across the corner, a slice of turquoise sea and sky through the window, a linen curtain moving, bright morning light, fresh and holiday-like.

shots.title: The building
shots.prompt: Architectural photograph from the beach of {anchor}: soft morning light on the white curves, sea-blue shutters half open, bougainvillea spilling from the planters, a few sun loungers and a striped umbrella on the sand in front, calm sea, nobody posing.

shots.title: The Blue Apartment
shots.prompt: A 2x2 grid of four separate photographs divided by thin white gutters, all four in one consistent style and light. A two-bedroom holiday apartment by the sea with chalk-white walls, oak floors, linen and rattan, accents of deep sea blue, bright natural light, nobody present. Top-left: the living room with a blue linen sofa and the sea through open doors. Top-right: a small kitchen with blue tiles and a bowl of lemons. Bottom-left: a bedroom with white linen and a blue throw facing the sea. Bottom-right: a shower room with blue zellige tiles and a round mirror.

shots.title: The Sand Penthouse
shots.prompt: A 2x2 grid of four separate photographs divided by thin white gutters, all four in one consistent style and light. A three-bedroom holiday penthouse by the sea with chalk-white walls, oak, linen and rattan in warm sand tones, bright natural light, nobody present. Top-left: a double-height living room with a curved sand-coloured sofa and the sea beyond. Top-right: a roof terrace with a plunge pool and sun loungers. Bottom-left: a family bedroom with two beds and striped linen. Bottom-right: an outdoor dining table under a white pergola at sunset. Every person is a clearly different individual (age, build, skin tone, hair and clothing all differ) so no face repeats; faces turned away or out of frame.

shots.prompt: Photograph of the quiet sea-facing courtyard of {anchor}: a small turquoise pool edged in white stone, olive trees in white planters, a few linen loungers, bougainvillea on the walls, afternoon light and soft shadows, peaceful, nobody present.
